name: Breaking Truce by Attacking a [country|e] with whom we have a relation involving defensive support
Declaring [war|e] without [casus_belli|e] on country with different Religion
Declaring [war|e] without [casus_belli|e] on country with the same Religion
Create Colonial Charter
description:
We will send [pops|e] from [SCOPE.sProvince('source').GetName] to [SCOPE.sProvinceDefinition('target').GetName] to establish a [colonial_charter|e].

[GetMonthlyMaintenanceInfoForCountry(SCOPE.sCountry('actor'),SCOPE.sProvinceDefinition('target'),SCOPE.sProvince('source').GetCapital)]

name: Abandon Colonial Charter
description: Abandoning the Colonial Charter for will stop the migration of pops. The [pops|e] that have migrated into [locations|E] we do not own will be abandoned by us.

name: Create Market
description: Create a new [market|e] in a target [location|e]. The [price|e] depends on the current [market_access|e] of the [location|e].

name: Relocate Market
description: Move a [market|e] to a different [location|e]

name: Train General
description: Spend [army_tradition|e] [army_tradition_i|e] to train a new [general|e]. They will not be allowed to be a member of our [cabinet|e].

name: Train Admiral
description: Spend [navy_tradition|e] [navy_tradition_i|e] to train a new [admiral|e]. They will not be allowed to be a member of our [cabinet|e].

name: Hire $game_concept_courtier$
description: Spend [government_power|e] to encourage a new [character|e] to enter our court.

name: Hire Artist
description: Encourage a new [artist|e] to enter our court.

name: Destroy Market
description: Destroy a [market|e].

name: Change Court Language
description:
Change our [country|e]'s [court_language|e]

We can change our Court Language to:
$BULLET$[common_language],
$BULLET$[liturgical_language],
$BULLET$[dominant_dialect|e],
$BULLET$The [market_language|e] of our [capital],
$BULLET$The language of an [accepted_culture|e],
$BULLET$Our ruler's language,
$BULLET$Our dynasty head's language,
$BULLET$The [court_language] of an [international_organization_leader|e],
$BULLET$The [court_language] of our [overlord|e].

name: Change Liturgical Language
description: Change our [country|e]'s [liturgical_language|e]

name: Invite Religious Figure from the same School
Invite Religious Figure from a new School
Invite Artist
description: Invite the [artist|e] to live and work in our [country|e]

name: Convert Religion
description: Change our [country|e]'s religion

name: Start Law Debate
description: [SCOPE.sInternationalOrganization('recipient').Custom('GetPolicyVoteDesc')]

name: Orthodox Synod
description: Call the Holy Synod. This is the highest authority in the Church, and it formulates the rules and regulations regarding matters of Church organization, faith, and order of service.

name: Periphora
description: Organize a periphora (Greek for 'procession'). This takes an icon [work_of_art|e] on the road, relocating it to another [location|e]! The icon spends about a month in each location along the route, granting those locations its art quality bonuses while in transit. Track its progress in the Works of Art map mode.

name: Invite Patriarch Delegation
description: We will invite a delegation from our Patriarch, so that we can both improve our relations and also discuss various matters of faith and the government of our country.

name: Canonize
description: [canonize|e] a [character|e], declaring them a saint and conferring extra benefits on our country scaled by how able they were when alive.

name: Invite Foreign Cleric
description: We will be sent an experienced clergyman from another country. It will anger our local [actor.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('clergy_estate')], but the expertise of this foreign cleric may be invaluable.

name: Select Omen
description: Our ruler will choose a god for guidance on choosing an [omen|e].

name: Host Olympiad
description: Our ruler will host a tournament of games at a [ShowReligionAdjective('hellenism_religion')] [holy_site|e] honoring the gods.

name: Sponsor a Feast for the Troops
description: By organizing a feast for our armies, we will keep the men in prime condition and morale, ensuring that they are eager to serve our country.

name: Grant a Triumph
description: Successes ought to be celebrated. A capable leader of armies should be thus presented to the populace as a victor in a spectacular triumphal parade.

name: Change Parliament Type
description: This will allow you to pick another [parliament_type|e] for your [country|e].

name: Change Organization Parliament Type
description: This will allow you to pick another [parliament_type|e] for the [international_organization|e].

name: Choose Employment System
description:
Set the [employment_system|e] our [country|e] will use to populate its [buildings|e].
[SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetActiveEmploymentSystemInfo]

name: Add Accepted Culture
description: Add a new [culture|e] as an [accepted_culture|e] in our [country|e]. If it is a kindred culture, it will not be costly to maintain.

name: Remove Accepted Culture
description: Demote one of the [accepted_cultures|e] of our [country|e] to [non_accepted_culture|e].

name: Add Tolerated Culture
description: Add a new [culture|e] as a [tolerated_culture|e] in our [country|e]. If it is a kindred culture, it will not be costly to maintain.

name: Remove tolerated Culture
description: Demote one of the [tolerated_cultures|e] of our [country|e] to [non_accepted_culture|e].

name: Change Primary Culture
description: Change the [primary_culture|e] of our [country|e] to another [accepted_culture|e].

name: Settle Country
description: We have established our religion and culture in these lands, let's make it official and [settle|e] here permanently so that we can work the fields and build improvements to better our situation in life.

name: Hire Privateer
description: Hire a [privateer|e] to pillage an [area|e].

name: Dismiss Privateer
description: Dismiss the [privateer|e] operating in the chosen [area|e].

name: Call $jihad$
description: Choose an infidel country to bring down the might of Allāh upon.

name: Join Sect
description: Join a [sect|e].

name: Disfavor Sect
description: Disfavor a [sect|e]. We will discourage its spread through our territory, although we will get extra penalties if we are in it.

name: Stop Disfavoring Sect
description: Stop disfavoring a [sect|e]. We will stop discouraging its spread through our territory and stop getting penalties if we are in it.

name: Promote Sect
description: Promote a [sect|e]. By promoting a $sect$ we will make it spread through our territory, and we will get more benefits from it if we are in it, although if we are part of multiple sects the other ones may not like it.

name: Stop Promoting Sect
description: Stop promoting a [sect|e]. We will stop encouraging the spread of the $sect$ through our territory, and we will stop getting the extra benefits if we are in it.

name: Leave Sect
description: Leave a [sect|e].

name: Perform a Tantric Ritual
description: Perform a religious ritual following Tantric practices.

name: Organize a Spiritual Retreat
description: Retire from worldly worries to achieve peace with the universe.

name: Commission Religious Images
description: Order some religious images to be created to show devotion.

name: Join Branch
description: Abandon our current [hindu_branch|e] and join a new one.

name: Activate Avatar
description: Activate an [avatar|e]. We need to have access to one of the Avatar's [holy_sites|e], either by owning it or by being allied to its [owner|e].

name: Deactivate Avatar
description: Deactivate an [avatar|e].

name: Change Avatar
description: Get a new [avatar|e].

name: Perform Yoga
description: Performs Yoga meditation.

name: Indulge in Feasts
description: Indulges in feasts.

name: Discard Worldly Possessions
description: Discard our worldly possessions

name: Indulge in Bloodbath
description: Indulge in killing our enemies

name: Favor a God
description: Favors one of the [gods|e], but it may upset the others

name: Join $autocephalous_patriarchate$
description: Join an [autocephalous_patriarchate|e].

name: Create Autocephalous Patriarchate
description: Create an [autocephalous_patriarchate|e].

name: Third Rome
description: Create a [holy_site|e] in our [autocephalous_patriarchate|e] seat.

name: Relocate Ecumenical Patriarchate
description: Move the seat of our [autocephalous_patriarchate|e] to a [holy_site|e] location to give additional bonuses.

name: Cleansing Ritual
description: Gain [purity|e] in exchange for our [prestige|e]

name: Celebrate a Ritual
description: Change our [yanantin|e] by sacrificing our [prestige|e] and resources to one of our Gods

name: Authorization for Expansion
description: We can persuade the $imperial_court$ to give us a justification to declare war on our neighbors to expand our influence.

name: Obtain Marriage
description: We can close our ties to the Imperial and Kuge families by getting a [marriage|e] with them with one of their minor members.

name: Become [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('japanese_shogunate').GetLeaderTitle]
description: We can persuade the $imperial_court$ to give us authorization to become [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('japanese_shogunate').GetLeaderTitle].

name: Appease the Elites
description: By handling the $shogunate_court$, we can keep the powerful families in check.

name: Increase Levies
description: We can request more [army_levies|e] and [navy_levies|e] from our stronger retainers through the $shogunate_court$.

name: Increase $game_concept_tax$ Income
description: We can request more [taxes|e] from our retainers through the $shogunate_court$.

name: Demand Extra Payment
description: We can ask for an immediate extra payment of [manpower|e] and [gold|e] through the $shogunate_court$.

name: Appease the Commoners
description: We can negotiate with the $ikko_ikki$ to keep the population happy.

name: Reduce Religious Rebel Progress
description: We can negotiate with the $ikko_ikki$ to reduce the risk of rebellion.

name: Allow Safe Refuge
description: The $ikko_ikki$ may prove us beneficial. We should allow them some safe refuge inside our territory.

name: Crackdown $ikko_ikki$ Strongholds
description: The $ikko_ikki$ may be more dangerous than they seem. We must spare no expense to ensure that they cannot fester inside our lands.

name: Increase $game_concept_literacy$
description: We can encourage the different $religious_sects$ to educate our populace.

name: Appease the Temples
description: We can negotiate with the different $religious_sects$ to keep them satisfied.

name: Favor [ShowReligionGroupAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('buddhist')] Schools
description: We can choose to favor [ShowReligionGroupName('buddhist')] schools, so that we can officially endorse one of them.

name: Favor Kami Worship
description: We will focus on Kami worship rather than on the teachings of [ShowReligionGroupName('buddhist')].

name: Balance Kami and Buddha
description: We will keep the worship of Kami and the teachings of Buddha balanced.

name: Baptize Ruler
description: This new Kirishitan faith and the foreigners that brought it seem interesting. Our ruler should get baptized to establish closer relations.

name: Hold Public Kirishitan Mass
description: The $kirishitan_monks$ are eager to spread their faith. Allowing them to hold mass publicly will help them do so faster, and benefit us from their favor.

name: Establish Kirishitan Treaty
description: The foreigners have ample goods and weapons we can get great benefit from, as long as we allow them to freely spread their religion.

name: Limit Kirishitan Movement
description: The $kirishitan_monks$ may become a nuisance more than a benefit. Limiting their movement may serve us good, although it will surely cause some discontent.

name: Pilgrimage
description: Visit a [holy_site|e] to strengthen our ties with our faith.

name: Host a Ceremony
description: A Ceremonial Festival is celebrated on a monthly basis, each time revolving around a different topic. This time we will invest the power of the government and make it larger than usual.

name: Organize a Roman Festival
description: Each calendar month has many festivals in honor of our many Gods, but on this occasion, we will use the power of the state to organize a splendid ceremony.

name: Revitalize an Ancient Greek Festival
description: Each region in our territory has a special festival in honor of one or more of our many Gods. We will make use of the power of the state to support every region, and reinforce their efforts to create the grandest ceremony ever known.

name: Host a Ceremony
description: A Ceremonial Festival is celebrated each uinal, equivalent to 20 days, each time revolving around a different topic. This time we will invest the power of the government and make it larger than usual.

name: Sacrifice Noble Blood
description: Our Gods need the blood of our people to maintain balance in heaven and earth. It is the duty of our nobles to give them their blood in ritual sacrifice, as their blood is the purest and most valuable of all.

name: Change Main School
description: Change the main [religious_school|e] of the [country|e]

name: Sell Icon
description: We will try to sell them a Religious Icon.

name: Religious Offering
description: Gain [purity|e] by offering a [work_of_art|e] to the Gods.

name: Migrate Pops
description:
#T Migrate Pops#!
Transfer [pops|e] from one [location|e] to another.

name: Add Location to International Organization
description: Adds the selected [location|e] to the specific [international_organization|e]

name: Remove Location from International Organization
description: Removes the selected [location|e] from the specific [international_organization|e]

name: Bribe Voter
description: Spend [prestige|e] and offer [gold|e] to a member so they vote for the outcome we choose in the current law debate.

name: Move Court into Hiding
description: This will reduce the risk that anyone in the court will die from the plague. This however will make the [pops|e] think we have abandoned them to their fate.

name: Isolate Cities
description: By ordering our cities to shut their walls, and restrict movement in, and out of them, we think we can limit the impact of the disease and bring about some much-needed control.

name: Control the Food Market
description: In these trying times our biggest priority is to ensure the supply of grain and other foodstuffs, forbidding its export. Even at the cost of angering the merchants of our nation.

name: Isolate the Country
description: The merchants and other travelers are bringing the scourge from other territories. To protect our people we are forced to completely close our borders to any trade no matter the cost to our economy.

name: No Contact with Outsiders
description: Everybody knows that foreigners and merchants from neighboring tribes have brought plague to our territory. To avoid the further spread of the scourge, we will cut all ties with our neighbors and close our borders to any trade, no matter the cost to our economy.

name: Segregate the Infected
description: The plague is running free in our country, we will bar the sick from leaving their houses to stop the spread of the sickness.

name: Expel the Sick
description: Those affected by the pest are dangerous, and their mere presence might spread the pestilence to the healthy, we must expel them from every community to give a chance to those that can still be saved.

name: Procure Remedies
description: This sickness can be fought and pushed back. Many doctors and priests claim that many recipes and remedies might improve the health of the sick, it is our duty to procure an ample supply of them.

name: Repeal '$procure_remedies$'
description: The many remedies and concoctions preached by healers and other swindlers as miraculous and infallible, have proven ineffective and even dangerous.

name: Sponsor Mass Forgiveness
description: The plague is a punishment from God for the sins of the people. We can fight it by organizing mass church services all around the country and encourage the populace to clean themselves from the stain of sin.

name: Repeal '$sponsor_sin_forgiveness$'
description: The many services have proven ineffective at stopping the contagion, it could be even said that those gathered in prayer have been even more prone to fall to the sickness.

name: Repeal '$blame_the_minorities$'
description: The religious minorities in our country have no part in the plague that affects us, we can not allow their continuous persecution.

name: Conduct $keju_examination$
description: The [ShowLawName('keju_examination')] is the backbone that supports our bureaucratic prowess. Capable students that have a distinct level of ability may be called upon to serve our court and ensure a smooth and efficient apparatus.

name: Reshape our Bureaucracy
description: Reform our Bureaucratic systems by retuning the political structures of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('middle_kingdom').GetName], so that our power will be strengthened, and our regime will grow solid like a golden fortress with boiling moat.

name: Strengthen Ministry
description: The [ShowLawNameWithNoTooltip('six_ministries')] are the basis of the government of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('middle_kingdom').GetName]. By dedicating more resources to one of them, its capacities may be reinforced.

name: Proclaim Decree
description: $middle_kingdom_decrees_desc$

name: Exempt from Tribute
description: The [ShowPaymentName('middle_kingdom_tribute')] of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('middle_kingdom').GetName] may sometimes be more a burden than a boon. We can release some countries from their tribute obligation to ease the strain that puts to our government.

name: Change Side to Support
description: We will betray our current court and join the other side.

name: Declare Neutrality
description: We will support neither side and remain neutral in our allegiance

name: Attempt Imperial Restoration
description: We must take advantage of the weakness of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('japanese_shogunate').GetName] and attempt to restore the power to the imperial line.

name: Force End War
description: Ravaging wars are damaging our country. We can make use of our imperial authority and force any belligerent clan to stop fighting by sending them an official imperial missive.

name: Revoke Land
description: Revoke some of the land allotted and restore it to the direct control of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('japanese_shogunate').GetName]. Chances that a clan will accept our demands depend on their [opinion|e] of us and our [diplomatic_reputation|e].

name: Limit Clan's Autonomy
description: The clans are getting out of our control and are acting independently disregarding our authority. We must force them to comply and follow the directives of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('japanese_shogunate').GetName]. Chances that a clan will accept our demands depend on their [opinion|e] of us and our [diplomatic_reputation|e].

name: Summon to Court
description: The clan leaders dismiss our authority. We should summon them to our court so that we can keep them under control, or use their refusal to obey such summons as a justification of their treachery. Chances that a clan will accept our demands depend on their [opinion|e] of us and our [diplomatic_reputation|e].

name: Proclaim Clan Independence
description: The [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('japanese_shogunate').GetName] has become weak and can no longer control the clans efficiently. We must take advantage of the situation and assert our independence from the authority of the $JAPANESE_SHOGUNATE_LEADER_MALE$

name: Increment Recruitment
description: Uncertain times are ahead, and wars will need to be fought. We should increase our armies with new recruits.

name: Offer Hostage
description: We can strengthen our ties with some of the other clans by sending them one of our family members as a hostage.

name: Ask for Hostage
description: We can ask for a clan to send us one of their family members as a hostage to strengthen our ties with them.

name: Prove Heritage
description: Our family comes from very far in the past, like all of them do in fact. We can try to 'find' some documents in our archives that prove exactly how ancient our lineage is, and how closely we are tied to the most important families and clans.

name: Grant Shugo Office
description: The provinces of $japan_region$ are sometimes difficult to govern, and thus provincial governors are appointed to extend the rule of the $JAPANESE_SHOGUNATE_LEADER_MALE$ to all the land.

name: Revoke Shugo Office
description: The position of Shugo of a province allows a family to amass quite a bit of power of influence there, but it can be revoked to avoid them becoming too contemptuous in their position.

name: Claim Shugo Office
description: The position of Shugo is one of power of prestige. Any clan with sufficient influence in a province may decide that they deserve that position, even if its contrary to the will of the $JAPANESE_SHOGUNATE_LEADER_MALE$.

name: Seek Relations with the Byzantines Price
Learn from Foreigners
description: There are many things that we can learn from these strange foreigners, some trade and good relationships will surely help our people.

name: Absorb Institutions
description: The strange ways of these foreigners have our people confused and scared, but surely there are many things we could learn from them and apply to our society.

name: Abandon Piracy
description: The age of raiding and plunder is at an end. Our foes must swear to cease their acts of piracy and lawlessness upon the seas.

name: Acquire Casus Belli
description: Get a [ShowCasusBelliName('cb_subjugation')] [casus_belli|e] to use against countries outside the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('lordship_of_ireland').GetName].

name: Request Planters
description: Send settlers from the homeland to bolster the faithful population.

name: Claim the Kingdom
description: The title of King of Ireland is finally ours for the taking, which will solidify our legitimacy over the land and its people.

name: Overthrow High King
description: The leadership of the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('high_kingship').GetName] must shift. No longer shall they claim dominion over the isle!

name: Migrate to New Waters
description: There are wealthier and more lucrative shores elsewhere in the world, and it is past time we discover them. In order to better find these far-off treasures, we can uproot our headquarters and move anywhere our fleet can reach.

name: Seek Support of Overlord's Rival
description: To fight our tyrannical overlords, we will need all the support we need. Luckily, there are those who are plotting the demise of our despicable sovereign every waking minute. We should seek good relations with them to establish a common diplomacy.

name: Declare Independence War
description: It is time to overthrow the chains of oppression and declare our independence from our overlord!

name: Grant Representation to Colonial Subject
description: It is time to allow our colonial subjects some representation in their own administration.

name: Establish Goods Act
description: By establishing a new act on goods or transactions, we will be able to siphon more money from our colonies.

name: Aid Colonial War Efforts
description: Aiding the war efforts of our colonial nations will go a long way in helping their consolidation and showing them the love we have for them.

name: Give Colony Rebellion Support
description: Give support to one of the colonial subjects of another country to nudge them towards rebellion.

name: Violate the $treaty_of_tordesillas$
description:
The $treaty_of_tordesillas$ is nothing more than a piece of meaningless paper for the people risking their lives in an attempt to carve a better future for themselves in an ungrateful and dangerous new land.

We will ignore these rulings and allow our people to take what is their right to have.

name: Demand the Transfer of a Claimed Province
description: The [GetCountry('PAP').GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle] gave us and only us, the right to colonize and rule this lands on the name of [GetCountry('PAP').GetReligion.GetGodName]. Those who transgress this heavenly mandate should transfer their land to us without complaining or face the consequences.

name: Exchange Claims
description: With the ratification of the $treaty_of_tordesillas$, the world has been split between the main colonial powers, but that is still not to our liking, and some amendment could be made to improve our position. We might entice one of those powers to exchange one of our claims to an area for their claims to a neighboring one.

name: Shifting the Line
description: The current split determined by the $treaty_of_tordesillas$ does not favor us as much as it should. We should shift the line separating the world a bit further to our advantage and make it clear to the world that we are not to be trifled with.

name: Exchange Sides
description: During the negotiations, it became clear to us that our rival's share of the world is much better that ours. We will use our reputation and prestige to try to convince them that it is in their interest to swap our claims with theirs.

name: Push to Settle Treaty
description: Making use of our influence over the [GetCountry('PAP').GetLongName] to speed the ratification and entry into force of the $treaty_of_tordesillas$ on its current form.

name: Upheld the Treaty Relevance
description: Defend the importance of the $treaty_of_tordesillas$ and its heavenly ordained righteousness.

name: Revoke a Claim
description:
A negotiation is always a back-and-forth process of successes and concessions; we are bound to allow our rivals to get what they want from time to time, it is part of the art of diplomacy to claw that advantage back afterwards.

By making use of our influence, we will convince the [GetCountry('PAP').GetLongName] to revoke one of the active claims of our cosignatory, moving the negotiation back to a point where we have the leading role.

name: Sponsor the Reformation
description: The ideas of $reformation$ are enticing and could be a benefit to our country! If we establish connections to those who preach these new ideas, we could hurry the spread within our country.

name: Purchase Work of Art
description: Purchase a [work_of_art|e] from another [country|e]'s collection.

name: Sell Work of Art
description: Offer a [work_of_art|e] from our collection to another [country|e] in exchange for gold.

name: Designate Province Capital
description: Designate this [location|e] as the permanent [province_capital|e], preventing automatic reassignment based on [population_growth|e].

name: Contact the Patriarch of Constantinople
description: Dispatch Melanchthon to Constantinople bearing our Confession of Faith, opening a channel of dialogue with the [ShowReligionAdjective('orthodox')] Patriarchate.
